item.title: Whiskers 0.8.21
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.21

### API Keys

  • New dedicated API Keys page for adding and managing keys across providers
  • Validate keys as you save them, with clearer guidance when a service is unavailable

    • ### Models & Providers

  • Improved cloud provider selection so the active model and provider stay in sync
  • Clearer “Active” state in model/provider lists

    • ### Accessibility & UI

  • Better VoiceOver coverage across key flows, plus improved Reduce Motion behavior
  • Refreshed settings UI with a more consistent “glass” look and cleaner layout

    • ### Bug Fixes

  • Fixed issues that could prevent pasting in some cases
  • Preserved dictionary/snippet whitespace more reliably
  • Reduced the chance of recording sessions getting stuck on hotkeys or audio state
